## Module to write
path: StarterPlayerScripts/FeatureVerifyClient.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Add executable checks and fix failures for: the SHOP button opens a panel listing every Upgrades entry with price and affordability, and buying Dropper 2 for 10 works once; the rebirth altar appears at 5000 cash or when all upgrades are owned, and rebirth applies the multiplier and resets cash and upgrades; the plaza TOP TYCOONS board lists Cash and Rebirths; the tutorial arrow and banner appear after the first claim and advance on the first purchase. Mark each feature verified when its checks pass. -- Client-side probe that stays inert unless the verify remotes exist (it WaitForChilds them with a timeout and exits on nil). On request from the server it inspects the player's own UI and replies with plain data. For SHOP, it finds the SHOP button in PlayerGui, activates it, and returns whether the panel is visible plus the list of cards (UpgradeId, price text, Affordable attribute). For TUTORIAL, it returns whether the banner and arrow are visible. It sends no gameplay intent to the server. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: feature_verified_shop, feature_verified_rebirth, feature_verified_board, feature_verified_tutorial.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/FeatureChecksConfig.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/ShopUi.client.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/TutorialGuide.client.luau

## Lessons from past builds
# This game's style and juice (from the director; apply wherever your module touches it)
- Palette: #FF8FD0, #FF6A2B, #7FE3FF, #4CD964, #B04CFF, #F2C46B, #FFD23F, #2B2D42; materials: SmoothPlastic, Neon, Grass, Sand, Ice, Slate, Wood; lighting: Bright late-morning ClockTime 14, Brightness 2.5, a light blue Atmosphere with low haze, Bloom (intensity 0.5, threshold 1.0) and ColorCorrection with Saturation 0.15 and slightly warm tint
- Use GameAssets (ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets.luau): play(name), burst(at), shake() on the client, part(props) for every world part. Sound names: Coin, Buy, Gem, Click, Pop, Error, Whoosh, Jump, Land, Boom, Splash, Hurt, Win, Music. Director sounds: Coin->Coin, Buy->Buy, Click->Click, Pop->Pop, Error->Error, Whoosh->Whoosh, Land->Land, Win->Win, Boom->Boom, Music->Music
- Juice: cube collected: soft short Coin tick, collector flashes bright yellow, tiny sparkle at the intake, floating +$N rises over the collector; HUD cash punches and ticks up; cube dropped: none (silent so it does not spam), small puff and a squash tween on the dropper nozzle; BuyPad affordable: pad turns green and pulses with a brighter Neon glow, PriceBillboard turns green and the HUD goal bar fills; upgrade purchased: Buy confirm chime, pad pops and vanishes, the new model rises with a Back tween, a sparkle burst follows, cash counter punches, Toast 'Unlocked: Dropper 2!', small shake; not enough cash: Error buzz, pad flashes red briefly, price text shakes, Toast 'Need $X more'; ore tier upgrade (Silver/Gold/Diamond): Win sting, cubes change to the new colour with a gem-coloured shockwave ring at the dropper, RewardPopup 'GOLD ORE! $30 per cube', medium shake and brief FOV punch; shop opened: Whoosh, dim backdrop fades in, Panel scales in with a Back tween; buy buttons punch on click with a Click sound; shop purchase: Buy, button flashes green and the card's level bar fills, level x/max ticks up and cash counter punches; multiplier bought: Win, the collector glows and its multiplier sign flips to 'x2', HUD income readout flashes and gets bigger for a moment, small shake; rebirth: Boom followed by Win, white flash, confetti and gold sparkle burst, plot rebuilds with a rise tween, RewardPopup 'REBIRTH! x1.5 forever'; Rebirths stat increases, large shake and FOV punch; tutorial step complete: Pop, arrow bursts into sparkles and re-appears on the next target, Toast with the next hint; leaderboard refresh: the player's row is highlighted with a soft glow, board entries slide to their new ranks

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~10-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance.
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).

```luau
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	return
end

local cfgModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FeatureChecksConfig", 10)
if not cfgModule then
	return
end
local Config = require(cfgModule)

-- Inert unless the verify remotes exist.
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.remotes.folder, 10)
if not remotesFolder then
	return
end
local requestRemote = remotesFolder:WaitForChild(Config.remotes.request, 10)
local responseRemote = remotesFolder:WaitForChild(Config.remotes.response, 10)
if not requestRemote or not responseRemote then
	return
end
if not requestRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not responseRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
	return
end

local GUI = Config.gui

local function playerGui(): PlayerGui?
	return player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

-- Walks up the ancestry and reports whether the instance is really showing.
local function isShown(inst: Instance?): boolean
	local cur: Instance? = inst
	while cur and cur ~= game do
		if cur:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if not cur.Visible then
				return false
			end
		elseif cur:IsA("ScreenGui") or cur:IsA("BillboardGui") or cur:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			if not cur.Enabled then
				return false
			end
		elseif cur:IsA("BasePart") then
			if cur.Transparency >= 0.99 then
				return false
			end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return inst ~= nil
end

local function findNamed(name: string): Instance?
	local pg = playerGui()
	if pg then
		local found = pg:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if found then
			return found
		end
	end
	local ws = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if ws then
		return ws
	end
	return nil
end

local function findGuiNamed(name: string, className: string?): Instance?
	local pg = playerGui()
	if not pg then
		return nil
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
		if d.Name == name and (className == nil or d:IsA(className)) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function firstPriceText(card: Instance): string
	local function textOf(i: Instance): string?
		if (i:IsA("TextLabel") or i:IsA("TextButton")) and string.find(i.Text, "%$") then
			return i.Text
		end
		return nil
	end
	local t = textOf(card)
	if t then
		return t
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
		local s = textOf(d)
		if s then
			return s
		end
	end
	return ""
end

local function tryActivate(button: Instance): boolean
	local ok = false
	local env = getfenv and getfenv() or nil
	local fire = env and env.firesignal
	if type(fire) == "function" and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		ok = pcall(function()
			fire(button.Activated)
			fire(button.MouseButton1Click)
		end)
	end
	return ok
end

local function probeShop(): { [string]: any }
	local result: { [string]: any } = { buttonFound = false, panelVisible = false, activated = false, cards = {} }
	local button = findGuiNamed(GUI.shopButton, nil)
	if button then
		result.buttonFound = true
		result.buttonVisible = isShown(button)
		local before = false
		local panelPre = findGuiNamed(GUI.shopPanel, nil)
		if panelPre then
			before = isShown(panelPre)
		end
		if not before then
			result.activated = tryActivate(button)
			task.wait(0.6)
		else
			result.activated = true
		end
	end
	local panel = findGuiNamed(GUI.shopPanel, nil)
	if panel then
		result.panelVisible = isShown(panel)
		local cards = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
			local id = d:GetAttribute(Config.shopCardAttributes.upgradeId)
			if id ~= nil then
				table.insert(cards, {
					UpgradeId = id,
					id = id,
					priceText = firstPriceText(d),
					price = d:GetAttribute(Config.shopCardAttributes.price),
					Affordable = d:GetAttribute(Config.shopCardAttributes.affordable),
					affordable = d:GetAttribute(Config.shopCardAttributes.affordable),
				})
			end
		end
		result.cards = cards
	end
	result.cardCount = #result.cards
	return result
end

local function probeTutorial(): { [string]: any }
	local banner = findNamed(GUI.tutorialBanner)
	local arrow = findNamed(GUI.tutorialArrow)
	local pg = playerGui()
	local bannerAttr = player:GetAttribute(Config.tutorialAttributes.bannerVisible)
	local arrowAttr = player:GetAttribute(Config.tutorialAttributes.arrowVisible)
	if pg then
		if bannerAttr == nil then
			bannerAttr = pg:GetAttribute(Config.tutorialAttributes.bannerVisible)
		end
		if arrowAttr == nil then
			arrowAttr = pg:GetAttribute(Config.tutorialAttributes.arrowVisible)
		end
	end
	local bannerVisible = banner ~= nil and isShown(banner)
	local arrowVisible = arrow ~= nil and isShown(arrow)
	if bannerAttr == true then
		bannerVisible = bannerVisible or banner == nil
	end
	if arrowAttr == true then
		arrowVisible = arrowVisible or arrow == nil
	end
	local text = ""
	if banner then
		for _, d in ipairs(banner:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text ~= "" then
				text = text .. d.Text .. " "
			end
		end
		if banner:IsA("TextLabel") then
			text = banner.Text
		end
	end
	return {
		bannerVisible = bannerVisible,
		arrowVisible = arrowVisible,
		bannerText = text,
		bannerExists = banner ~= nil,
		arrowExists = arrow ~= nil,
	}
end

local function collectText(root: Instance): string
	local parts = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			table.insert(parts, d.Text)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function probeBoard(): { [string]: any }
	local board = Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.workspaceNames.board, true)
	local text = board and collectText(board) or ""
	return {
		boardFound = board ~= nil,
		text = text,
		hasTitle = string.find(string.upper(text), Config.workspaceNames.boardTitle, 1, true) ~= nil,
		hasCash = string.find(text, "%$") ~= nil or string.find(string.lower(text), "cash", 1, true) ~= nil,
		hasRebirths = string.find(string.lower(text), "rebirth", 1, true) ~= nil
			or string.find(text, "R%d") ~= nil,
	}
end

local function probeRebirth(): { [string]: any }
	local button = findGuiNamed(GUI.rebirthButton, nil)
	local altar = Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.workspaceNames.altar, true)
	return {
		buttonFound = button ~= nil,
		buttonVisible = button ~= nil and isShown(button),
		altarFound = altar ~= nil,
		altarVisible = altar ~= nil and isShown(altar),
	}
end

local probes: { [string]: () -> { [string]: any } } = {
	shop = probeShop,
	tutorial = probeTutorial,
	board = probeBoard,
	rebirth = probeRebirth,
}

local busy = false

requestRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
	local feature: string? = nil
	local requestId: any = nil
	local function absorb(v: any)
		if type(v) == "string" then
			if probes[v] then
				feature = v
			elseif requestId == nil then
				requestId = v
			end
		elseif type(v) == "number" then
			if requestId == nil then
				requestId = v
			end
		elseif type(v) == "table" then
			local f = v.feature or v.kind or v.name
			if type(f) == "string" and probes[f] then
				feature = f
			end
			local id = v.requestId or v.id or v.token
			if id ~= nil then
				requestId = id
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do
		absorb(v)
	end
	if not feature or busy then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	local ok, data = pcall(probes[feature])
	busy = false
	local payload: { [string]: any } = {
		feature = feature,
		kind = feature,
		requestId = requestId,
		id = requestId,
		ok = ok,
		data = ok and data or { error = tostring(data) },
	}
	if ok and type(data) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(data) do
			if payload[k] == nil then
				payload[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	pcall(function()
		responseRemote:FireServer(payload)
	end)
end)
```
